scope: Targeted addendum: seven studies and one correction. Not an exhaustive systematic review. Separate from the original audience-v3 source register.

sources.title: Putnam and Phelps (2017), The citation effect
sources.scope_limit: Small pooled effect on truth judgments; not longitudinal brand trust.
sources.access: Indexed primary abstract reviewed; direct PubMed open returned a stub.

sources.title: Heiss et al. (2024), Scientific credibility cues in short-form videos
sources.scope_limit: Scientific-reference manipulation did not improve content credibility; one mental-health topic.
sources.access: Indexed primary article and PDF text reviewed; direct publisher open returned 403. Correction checked.

sources.title: Correction to Heiss et al.
sources.access: Indexed publisher correction text reviewed; direct open returned 403.

sources.title: Peng et al. (2019), Comparing and modeling via social media
sources.design: Comparison-direction manipulation; 1,428 male Instagram users in Taiwan
sources.scope_limit: Supports self-improvement motives from upward comparison; not actual channel growth.
sources.access: Author-institution abstract opened; publisher indexed abstract reviewed, direct publisher open returned 403. Full methods not appraised.

sources.title: Edelblum et al. (2025), The Beauty Backfire Effect
sources.design: Mock-post experiments; mainly female influencers, male follow-up
sources.scope_limit: Reduced relatability and stated engagement for high attractiveness; muscle size not isolated.
sources.access: Publisher full text reviewed including gender limitation and intention-based measures.

sources.title: Yee et al. (2020), Fitspiration, thinspiration and male body image
sources.design: Randomized repeated image exposure; 223 men, seven days
sources.scope_limit: Fitspiration increased body dissatisfaction versus neutral; not a clothed fictional-guide test.
sources.access: Primary publisher abstract and study overview reviewed.

sources.title: Fox and Bailenson (2009), Virtual Self-Modeling
sources.scope_limit: Self-resembling models influenced exercise; personalized immersive representations differ from generic video characters.
sources.access: Author-lab summary and indexed original PDF abstract reviewed; publisher direct open returned 403.

sources.title: Arigo et al. (2021), Fitspiration messaging and exercise behavior
sources.design: Randomized experiment, 655 college students; seven-day attendance
sources.scope_limit: Main predicted message benefits unsupported; motivation and behavior require separate measures.
sources.access: Primary open article abstract and methods reviewed.
